Introduction

Canary is a South Korean virtual singer under HYBE Labels. She is a member of the South Korean virtual girl group SYNDI8.

According to her backstory, she is a member of the Canary tribe (Serinus canaria), with her father serving as the chieftain. Additionally, her special item is a magical wand
